import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class MaxFlowMinCost {
        int n, m, k, t;
        int[] u, v, dist, flow, pre, preEdge, prevNode, potential;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;

        class Edge {
            int to, f, cap, cost, rev;
            Edge(int to, int f, int cap, int cost, int rev) {
                this.to = to;
                this.f = f;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.cost = cost;
                this.rev = rev;
            }
        }

        MaxFlowMinCost(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            u = new int[n];
            v = new int[n];
            dist = new int[n];
            flow = new int[n];
            pre = new int[n];
            preEdge = new int[n];
            prevNode = new int[n];
            potential = new int[n];
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
            adj.get(s).add(new Edge(t, 0, cap, cost, adj.get(t).size()));
            adj.get(t).add(new Edge(s, 0, 0, -cost, adj.get(s).size() - 1));
        }

        int[] minCostMaxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int totalFlow = 0;
            int totalCost = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
                pq.offer(new int[]{0, s});
                dist[s] = 0;
                flow[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] cur = pq.poll();
                    int d = cur[0], u = cur[1];
                    if (d != dist[u]) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
                        int v2 = e.to;
                        if (e.f >= e.cap) continue;
                        int newDist = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[v2];
                        if (dist[v2] > newDist) {
                            dist[v2] = newDist;
                            pq.offer(new int[]{newDist, v2});
                            pre[v2] = u;
                            preEdge[v2] = i;
                            flow[v2] = Math.min(flow[u], e.cap - e.f);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dist[t] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
                }
                int df = flow[t];
                for (int v2 = t; v2 != s; v2 = pre[v2]) {
                    Edge e = adj.get(pre[v2]).get(preEdge[v2]);
                    e.f += df;
                    adj.get(v2).get(e.rev).f -= df;
                    totalCost += df * e.cost;
                }
                totalFlow += df;
            }
            return new int[]{totalFlow, totalCost};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        MaxFlowMinCost mf = new MaxFlowMinCost(6 + 107 * n);

        for (int _ = 0; _ < k; _++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            x--;
            mf.addEdge(0, 1 + x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            x--;
            y--;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 104; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= 50; j++) {
                    mf.addEdge(1 + i * n + x, 1 + (i + 1) * n + y, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                    mf.addEdge(1 + i * n + y, 1 + (i + 1) * n + x, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 104; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                mf.addEdge(1 + i * n + j, 1 + (i + 1) * n + j, 51, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 104; i++) {
            mf.addEdge(1 + i * n, 1 + 105 * n, 51, 0);
        }

        int[] result = mf.minCostMaxFlow(0, 1 + 105 * n);
        System.out.println(result[1]);
    }
}
